source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Sorry I haven't been in touch for a few days, I've been in development mode getting ready for launch. I'd like to get back to the website as of course this will be an integral part. Areas I would like to review and plan include:

1\. finalize assets and layout for the initial landing page design and responsive behavior

2\. basis for further website pages, e.g. will they carry common headers and footers, be "dark mode" or will there be a complimentary "light mode" style (I don't mean switchable).

3\. what guidance and/or rules can we define for general responsive behavior

4\. layout and styling of the dashboard shell and "canvas"

FYI, I have attached some screens from the secure signup and login flow that leverage AWS Cognito. These currently use AWS default styling but there are a range of self styling options available.

Some of the above fit within the current job but some fall outside of it. How do you suggest we move forward? Should we schedule a meeting or video call to discuss?

Mark
